content:
molly: Heads up — I'm proposing we reroute new signups into a tiered welcome drip instead of the single welcome email. Goal: improve early activation and webinar RSVPs. Quick reactions?

diego: SGTM. What's the primary segmentation? region, signup_source, initial usage?

molly: Primary: country + signup_source. Secondary: whether they hit an onboarding milestone (first API call / first dashboard flow). Idea is Tier A = high-intent (US/CA + github/partner signup or did first API call). Tier B = rest.

kate: Can we include a webinar invite on day 3 for Tier A? That has worked before for product-led signups. :calendar:

mark: Agree. Metrics to track: welcome email CTR, 7-day activation (first meaningful action), and webinar RSVP conversion. Also add utm_campaign=welcome-reroute for tracking.

sanjay: From infra side, we can route using the email-flows service. Proposed rule in Console: /email/flows/welcome_reroute -> fluent match to segments. I'll add the routing config. Example rule (pseudo):

```
segment_rules:
  - name: tier_a
    conditions:
      - country in ["US","CA"]
      - signup_source in ["github","partner"]
      - first_api_call == true
  - name: tier_b
    conditions:
      - otherwise
```

sanjay: Implementation note — we can use prefix caching on redis for signup_source checks, keep eval cheap.

diego: A/B test question: do we run the tiered flow vs current single-email baseline? I'd vote yes, run for 2 weeks, 50/50 traffic.

molly: Yes — diego, set up AB test with 50/50 random assign. Use the marketing AB dashboard and report after 14 days.

kate: Copy & localization: I'll draft copy for Tier A and Tier B and hand off to l10n for EU/APAC. Target to finish by Thu EOD.

mark: Sales/SDR routing: when someone in Tier A opens 2+ emails or clicks pricing, we should create an inbound lead. Can we tag with lead_source=welcome_reroute and priority=high?

sanjay: We can emit a webhook from the flow to /webhooks/crm with payload { email, segment, event, utm_campaign }. Suggest rate-limit 5/s.

molly: Great — @sdr-team please monitor inbound queue for first week and report false positives.

deploy-bot: Draft flow created at /email/flows/welcome_reroute/drafts/1717654321 by molly. Scheduled draft review: 2025-06-18 16:00 UTC.

kate: QA checklist: inbox rendering (mobile/desktop), alt-text on images, tracking params, unsubscribe link, localization strings, link validation. I'll run the first pass.

diego: Reminder: include a suppression for existing customers and trial extensions. Use suppression list: customers_and_trial_ext.json

molly: Timeline: copy & l10n by Thu, routing rules + infra ready Fri, AB test flip next Tue, measurement checkpoint after 14 days. I'll post the KPI dashboard link when ready. :rocket:

mark: +1. Anything else?

kate: I'll add the webinar invite template and RSVP tracking pixel to the Tier A Day 3 email.

molly: Awesome — thanks team. I'll follow up with a short PRD and link to the draft in this thread tomorrow.
